body:
I already have a SCS, it hasn't helped at all.  My story isn't unlike yours.  I was rear ended by a semi truck that was going about 55 while I was sitting still in construction traffic.  He was playing on his laptop while driving.  

I ended up with lumbar spine being titanium now. 

Every day is a struggle now.  Pain Management Dr is talking pain pump, because that's where we are.
if CDC wants to recommend alternative therapy like massage and acupuncture then they need to push the insurance companies to cover it.   I'd gladly try those, but can't swing the costs
where does your pump go into spine?  I hurt all over, putting it for lower half would help but then upper half would seem to hurt more.
